items.heading: Sadza with Muriwo
details: Key ingredients: corn meal, water, leafy greens, tomato
Cook corn meal with water into a thick, smooth dough (sadza).
Simmer chopped leafy greens with tomato and onion.
Season the greens well and cook until tender.
Serve the sadza alongside the vegetable relish.

items.heading: Bota
details: Key ingredients: corn or millet meal, peanut butter, sugar
Cook corn or millet meal with water into a thin, smooth porridge.
Stir in a spoonful of peanut butter for richness.
Sweeten lightly with sugar to taste.
Serve warm as a breakfast porridge.
